about.text: I build interactive experiences, on the web and in games. I’d love to work on creative, passion-driven projects.
On the web, I have 10+ years of front-end experience. I enjoy creating scroll-driven animation and interactive 3D WebGL. I’ve contributed to building large-scale platforms and Web3 solutions.

In games, I work in Unreal Engine with a focus on gameplay programming, including VR interactions. I’ve collaborated on the immersive experience “Ocean Threshold” and have shipped the VR game “Gnarly Crawl” as a solo developer.
